focused.visualCheck: Complete visible sentence agrees with the PDFium composition. Pixels differ, so this is not exact rendering parity.

behavior: Compatibility parsing routes lexical failure at the declared stream end through the existing bounded stream recovery. Strict mode retains lexical rejection. No token rules or filter validation changed.
limits: Existing recovery searches within input up to one MiB beyond declared payload end. Encoded bytes are not interpreted as page tokens at this boundary.
limitations: Single-file timing is not a throughput benchmark. Full PDF.js counts have not been rerun at this build.
